Talent0_2Ability.name: Intrepid Fang
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacked from within <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles and both Arms are undestroyed, launches <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block Melee attacks.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Intrepid Fang
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacked from within <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles and both Arms are undestroyed, launches <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Toss]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block Melee attacks.
When [Zoey] is on the battlefield, enemy units with <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> deal <color=#F74848>15%</color> less damage when attacking targets other than [Zoey], and take <color=#F74848>15%</color> increased damage from [Zoey].

600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Trigger <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) allies from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

601102.name: Unbreakable Will
601102.SpecificEffects: When both arms are intact, DMG taken on arms are reduced by <color=#F74848>25%</color>.

601103.name: Encroach
601103.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. When being retaliated against, gains <color=#F74848>20%</color> Dodge Rate.

601104.name: Challenge Formation
601104.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack all targets within an I-shaped (<color=#F74848>3x1</color>-tile) area or L-shaped (<color=#F74848>3x1</color>-tile) area ahead, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9x</color> AoE DMG. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=6011042>[Upper Hand]</buf> for each target hit, stacking up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times.

601105.name: Seize Momentum
601105.SpecificEffects: When completely dodging an attack, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601106.name: Lightning Hunt
601106.describe: Uses a Polearm to <range type=1>thrust 4 tiles forward</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.7x</color> DMG to the first target hit and inflicting <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601107.name: Chaotic Advance
601107.SpecificEffects: For each enemy on the battlefield with <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, gains Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>12%</color>.

601108.name: Final Verdict
601108.describe: Selects an empty tile within <range type=0>4-adjacent</range> tiles, jumps to the target type and uses Polearm to deal <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> AoE DMG to all enemies within <range type=1>2-adjacent</range> tiles of the target, inflicting <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> on all enemies hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601131.name: Survival Protocol 1
601131.SpecificEffects: When actively attacked, if a Dodge is triggered, recovers <color=#F74848>4%</color> max HP to all undestroyed parts. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> hit dodged, additionally recovers <color=#F74848>1%</color> more HP, up to <color=#F74848>8%</color> additional HP.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

601134.name: Survival Protocol 2
601134.SpecificEffects: When completely dodging an attack, <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Protocol 1]</buf> effect can additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

601135.name: Survival Protocol 3
601135.SpecificEffects: When HP drops below <color=#F74848>50%</color> after taking damage, gains <buf ID=1008062>[Absolute Dodge]</buf> after combat. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time, with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

601136.name: Survival Protocol 4
601136.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Protocol 1]</buf> after-combat recovery increases to <color=#F74848>10%</color> max HP for all undestroyed parts.

601141.name: Predatory Impulse 1
601141.SpecificEffects: After using <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> for <color=#F74848>3</color> times, the next active attack will not consume AP, and can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. This effect is removed after triggering.

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now be triggered an unlimited number of times per turn.

601145.name: Predatory Impulse 3
601145.SpecificEffects: After activating <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill>, applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> to all targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601146.name: Predatory Impulse 4
601146.SpecificEffects: <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> DMG dealt increases to <color=#F74848>1x</color> AoE DMG.

hiddenSkills.name: Sync-Guard
hiddenSkills.describe: Protects allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from assault and ranged attacks, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Additionally inflicts <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> on all enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

Introduction: Colin's adjutant, a hot-headed and defiant man of action.
